name: vital-decision-companion
description: Coaches a leadership decision on its own connector, and calls Ontology Navigator and Verify tools when a score or a claim check is needed. It does not copy those tools.

decision_key.title: VITAL Decision Companion key
decision_key.description: The vdec_ key. The host sends it only to the Decision Companion connector.

navigator_key.title: VITAL Ontology Navigator key
navigator_key.description: Optional vont_ key. Used only for decide_* and methods_* on the Navigator connector.

verify_key.title: VITAL Verify key
verify_key.description: Optional vvfy_ key. Used only for qualify_source and check_claim on the Verify connector.
